metric_definitions.phase: Index modulo64;0..47 nonrecording ordinary,48..62 recording ordinary,63 boundary of CURRENT controller only. Other arms use matched positions.
metric_definitions.global_nonempty_m_tiles: Sum over physical experts ceil(route_count / observed BLOCK_SIZE_M), summed once over owner ranks.
metric_definitions.counted_tile_flops_proxy: Two matmuls with observed M/N/K tiling;2*tileM*(rounded2I*roundedH+roundedH*roundedI), summed over nonempty M tiles.
metric_definitions.allocated_launch_extent: Pinned source formula, includes early-return programs; not observed Nsight grid measurements.

limitations: Descriptive phase associations are not exclusive causal stage timings.
Current/fix same assignment guarantees equal work proxies only with the attested common tile configuration.
Equal global nonempty expert tiles do not imply equal launched programs, cache traffic, hardware instructions or runtime.
Proxy FLOPs and useful fraction are not SM/tensor-core utilization, HBM bytes or roofline measurements.
MBPP sentinel is reported separately and never pooled into the main summary.
Independent execution/statistics audits remain required; this script adds no decision gate.
